research_findings: The system lacked a rate limiting mechanism for the waitlist signup feature.
Upstash Redis and Ratelimit are the ideal tools for implementing robust rate limiting in a serverless Next.js environment.
Testing the Next.js `headers` API and external services like Redis requires proper mocking in Vitest.
features_improved: The waitlist signup endpoint (`src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`) has been refactored to include IP-based rate limiting.
The signup flow now smoothly handles rate limit errors and degrades gracefully if Redis is unreachable.
new_features_added: Rate limiting for the waitlist signup to prevent abuse (e.g., 5 requests per hour per IP).
next_steps_for_next_run: Expand rate limiting to other sensitive endpoints like authentication or API key generation.
Monitor the waitlist rate limiting analytics in Upstash to determine if the 5 requests/hour threshold needs tuning.
